reviews.text: I always have a great experience here with my special girl Bella. the practice manager Trayelle is so welcoming , Dr long is such a wonderful veterinarian and Emma for always taking care of her . 😊😊 …
Dr. Long and the team (Tia was wonderful) here are great. Highly recommend. Half-off vaccs on Wednesday!

My visit was due to my dog’s urgent skin issue (infected hot spot) that needed addressing, but didn’t yet warrant going to an ER. My vet is not open on Saturday and it’s nearly impossible to find a last-minute appointment anywhere. They post their availability online (this is so HELPFUL instead of having to call a dozen places). The registration process was also online and so simple.

The care was fantastic and they were so kind. The appointment started and ended on time and they provided a detailed quote prior to administering the wound care. 14/10 would recommend!

I have been bringing my babies here for years, and we LOVEEEE this staff. Two years ago, when my senior cat's health began to decline, the staff was incredibly attentive, empathetic, and helpful before, during and after my boy crossed the rainbow bridge. Since then, Carrigan and I come for her all her needs, including nail trims, especially, nail trims! I’ve even brought a couple found cats for medical attention, and never felt pressured or guilt for denying any service. Emma is my family's favorite, she has been there as long as I've been going to this location, loved Absylum, and absolutely LOVES Carrigan. We will continue to reccommend Thrive Fountain View as long as they'll have us!
They take the best care of my sweet dog. We love Emma and Dr. Long. Have been coming here for years and they are wonderful.
They were amazing for both Leo & Astro
they are so kind and loving to my dogs! i wouldn’t want to go anywhere else!

We have been coming here since we moved from New York to Houston my cocker spaniel Lola is always treated with love and respect from the wonderful staff. The staff is kind and knowledgeable and they have taken care of anything from vaccinations to dealing with in ulcerated leg and they make sure that she stays healthy. We love them very much!

My Hazel loves them and so do I💙

They always listen to my concerns and are candid about their own regarding the best care for my pup. They are always real with me about what’s extremely necessary and where I can wait to remain affordable.
Bella had so much fun her first visit at thrive. Her visit was smooth and everyone friendly. The vet was awesome!
We brought in our 2 cats for nose to tail wellness exams and had a great experience. Great service and great pet care we are happy we choose Thrive Pet Healthcare in Fountain view.

I can’t recommend this vet enough!! I take my 2 cats and dog here for all their veterinary needs. My dog has CHF and requires a lot of care and medications. Dr. Long and the other veterinarians there have always been so caring and sweet with Jackie. Huge shoutout to Emma as well. She jumped through hoops for Jackie to make sure he wouldn’t miss a dose of medication. 10/10 I will always take my pets here. <3
Awesome very friendly staff.
I received amazing professional service for my sweet Frenchie, Almond, for her nail trim.  I highly recommend Thrive Pet Healthcare-Fountainview.
Great staff

I love bringing my three pets to this Thrive clinic because Dr. Long and Ms. Emma have always been very kind, warm and caring.  I feel Dr. Long is a great veterinarian who gives my TobyBoy the special care his condition requires. Ms Emma keeps up with the refill meds when I need them, and is always very kind and supportive.
Staff is very helpful. I like this Clinic.
Friendly and quite helpful with my questions. My pets were handled with care. I appreciate it very much.
I love talking my fur babies to Thrive, the staff is very sweet and professional, they take great care of them, thank you all!!

I called to canceled my pet appointment because they don’t have any availability for my second pet this is my first time with the vet , it doesn’t show it reflect on the app I called just to make sure Christopher from front desk very rude and not pleasant I haven’t been in there in person but the treatment I received over the phone was not friendly I would not be coming to location at all I rather go to other location they are more friendly and sweet over the phone.. They need to find someone better at front desk who is friendly , Horrible customer service from Christopher

I love this location! My girl is very timid and fearful when going to the vet and they make sure that not only she is comfortable but us as well. We appreciate all that they do and recommend them highly!

Very timely with the appointment.  Friendly staff, professional service; very caring and respectful of our cat, and our finances. Generous gift of a discount on our first visit.  Provided just what was needed and did not oversell on anything, but offered other services to keep our kitty healthy.  Greatly appreciated the care!!!

We have had pets for over 20 years and through 4 states and Thrive has been the best by far. If we weren't moving out of Texas, I would never stop using them. Their prices were amazing, the care and attention was Above and Beyond. My cat Hates strangers. Took her in for anxiety. She let them pet her and was happy purring. I definitely recommend Thrive on Fountain View
Always been happy with their service for our little Ella!💕
Pretty nice staff.

I visited this veterinary clinic because a friend recommended it, and I’m so glad I did! I didn’t realize you needed an appointment, but they went out of their way to accommodate me. I was able to get in within 20 minutes, which was a huge relief since the clinic is a bit far from my house. I especially loved that I could bring both of my dogs—they didn’t hesitate to treat them both with such care, even though only one had an appointment. My other vet always left my dogs feeling scared, but here, they were calm and comfortable. Now, my pup is already showing signs of improvement—she’s sleeping better, and I’m really hopeful about the meds they gave me. I’ll definitely be bringing my babies  here from now on. Highly recommend!
Receptionists and doctors are friendly. Techs are rude and need to improve their customer service skills.
Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview is wonderful! Dr. Long is very kind and understanding and the vet techs really know their stuff. 5 stars!
Great place. Friendly staff. I highly recommend.
amazing staff very nice environment very clean, seen us very quickly and took amazing care of my puppy

My normal experience with my dog at this location is just average, but generally we get what we need and move on (except for that time my dog had an allergic reaction to the arthritis shot, and the doctor told me that the only way we could prove it was the shot was to give it again…ummm no, over my dead body will I make my dog experience another allergic reaction and tremors!) now, I’ve been getting 18 text messages and active spam phone calls to remind me that my dog needs a rabies shot, and I don’t need help making an appointment, as I literally made one and went in like 1.5 weeks ago. When I asked the woman who called me, TT (sp?), how to opt out of these calls and texts over the phone, she continued to speak over the top of me for 15-20 seconds, like, it took real effort because most people naturally stop speaking when they hear another person trying to say something, and in customer service they certainly apologize and say something like “oh I’m sorry, what were you saying?” But that did not happen with TT. When she wouldn’t stop speaking and listen to me, I just started speaking non-stop until she stopped, because otherwise I was never going to get her to stop speaking and listen. When that happened, I was just saying things like “I can keep speaking for hours on end too,  but I just want to opt out of these marketing calls. How do I opt out?” Over and over, to which she responded saying that I was rude (as if she hadn’t been rude the whole time) and then she hung up the phone without answering my question about how to opt out. Well the good thing about caller ID is, I am able to call her back, and I did that, and politely informed her that she hung up on me without answering my question, and that I would like to opt out of these marketing calls, and only then did she say “I’m putting a note in your chart that you don’t want to receive reminder calls”, and what I don’t understand is, why couldn’t she just say that from the beginning, and we could both move on? Why couldn’t she stop talking over me long enough to listen, and then just say something like “hey, sorry, some people like these calls, I understand you don’t, and I’ll write that in your chart and hopefully that’ll take care of it for you.” TT or Teetee, however you spell it, should very definitely not be in customer service, she’s more like a high pressure business funding salesman from New Jersey worried about pushing the sale,  than she is worried about customer experience  and reputation of the company. Even if you talk over people in your personal life because you’re type A, you never ever do that while performing a role in customer service. This makes me want to cancel my monthly subscription to this place immediately. What a terrible way to be woken up from a dead sleep first thing in the morning.
I have been coming to thrive fountainview for years with our dog Yuki and cat Suki. We always feel well taken care of and the staff has always been welcoming for our pets.
The team at Thrive Pet Healthcare on Fountainview does a fabulous job. They are caring, knowledgeable and friendly. They take great care of my 2 Pomeranians. I highly recommend them.
The staff is super nice and patient being a 1st time pet owner it was encouraging going to thrive and making them our vet for our new fur baby would recommend 10x over

I have visited this location several times with a friend! Every appointment from the receptionist, nurse and doctors are all so friendly and professional. I decided to get my own pup and become a member! Here I am today at my first visit and I am getting the same star treatment, friendly nice staff and fast service! I left more knowledgeable about my pup and excited to return for future follow up visits!

We had such a great experience at Thrive. The office was clean, safe, and very efficient from start to finish. Dr. Long was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful throughout our dog’s neutering procedure, taking the time to answer questions and make us feel comfortable every step of the way. The staff was kind, organized, and clearly cared about both pets and their owners. We truly felt our dog was in great hands and would absolutely recommend this clinic to others.
Professional, experienced and very friendly
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview.
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback. Thank you for choosing Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview.
Love coming to Thrive for my little Bentley! Always a pleasant and transparent experience and the staff is amazing. Our nurse Emma was an angel!
Jenna was wonderful, she was really knowledgeable and explained things clearly. The staff was super attentive and friendly.
Lovely, kind and caring staff.
This a great place. The staff is friendly, professional, and loves pets. Always so kind, and helpful.

This was one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had at a vet clinic. My appointment was at 2:00 PM, and I was put into an exam room and left there for over an hour with absolutely no communication. No updates, no explanation, nothing. No one came in until after 3:00 PM.

I understand that clinics can be understaffed and that delays happen, but to have me wait that long and then tell me you can’t help my sick cat is completely unacceptable. That should have been communicated from the beginning. Instead, my time was wasted and my pet’s condition was not taken seriously.

When the doctor finally came in, she told me my cat needed tests but then said she couldn’t do them because she had to leave for the day. It felt rushed and dismissive, like she just wanted to go home instead of actually helping. After waiting over an hour, being told nothing could be done is honestly unbelievable.

Then I was told to go to an emergency clinic, knowing how expensive those visits are. That should have never been the outcome after sitting there waiting for care.

I didn’t get the doctor’s name, but it was whichever doctor was scheduled on Monday, March 30.

The front desk staff was kind, but the doctor’s behavior was extremely unprofessional. She was literally leaving the clinic as I was walking out, which made it very clear where her priorities were.

I ended up going to another vet who took my cat in right away and performed the necessary tests. This clinic failed to provide even basic care. I would not trust them with my pet again.
My puppy had a great experience as I thank you!!!!

Staff is very nice and attentive . After first visit my dog is comfortable going there. We are always well taken care of. Prices are competitive  . They give you the break down of the services perform immediately before they do anything so clients can make their choice of service ahead of time. Easy check in, good follow up after visit.  I’m satisfied with the  care .

I love my doctor and nurses as well as the facility here, Titi and Jack are always so kind and knowledgeable. They’re helpful and treat my babies so well. I also want to thank Dr Long because she has taken such great care of the animals here and I appreciate the work the team does for us all. Thank you for keeping my babies healthy! Thank you for the great staff and the excellent work!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5‑star review. We’re pleased to know your experience at our clinic met your expectations. Thank you for choosing us!
I love this place an the staff an doctor is very amazing
I can always count on with the people in this facility to take care of my four-legged child.

I truly felt that the wellbeing of my cats were prioritized at this clinic. Emma and Maggie were so sweet to my cat and thoroughly explained what they were going to do to figure out what may be wrong with him. They made efficient but cost-effective decisions to figure out the best plan without breaking the bank! The cost seemed reasonable, and I appreciate them having same day appointments and opening on Saturdays. I noticed they had Feliway diffusers in the exam rooms which I think helped my cat stay calm. They make a trip to vet stress free and I will definitely continue bringing my cats here!

Terrific experience!  I took my 17 year old cat here and she was treated VERY well and solved her issue.  The vet and Jack couldn't have been any kinder!  I will be back with any other needs she or her sister have.  Thank you!!

EDITED TO ADD: I took my now, 18 year old sister in for an eye infection.  Dr. O and staff took very good care of Barbara and prescribed a medicine that worked immediately.  These ladies are the BEST!
Hit or miss sometimes but prices are reasonable and keeps us coming back
We're utterly delighted to hear about your experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview. Thank you for your review!

I have been taking my baby to thrive for almost 6 years now. I moved down from the DFW area about 3 years ago and was worried my experience wasn't going to be as good as the location up there. The location on Fountainview has more than exceeded my expectations. Not only am I always greeted warmly when Reese (my dog) and I walk in, but everyone there is so kind and welcoming. At Thrive they care about your babies just as much as you do. They want to get the best care at the best cost for you and will work with you to get the best price possible to care for your babies health and wellness. I would recommend Thrive to any pet parent I know.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating!

After my cat Mayzie had an overnight stay at an Emergency Vet Hospital, I was not satisfied with her care and overwhelmed by the medications I was sent home with. The ER Vet was not responding so late that night, I went to Thrive's website and was able to book her an appointment for the following morning.

Mayzie had already been through a few stressful days, and I worried about further stressing her by going back to another Vet, but she was still not acting herself.

When we arrived at Thrive, Emma, kindly greeted us as soon as we walked in the door and promptly began the check-in process. I noticed Mayzie was barely yelling and seemed much more calm than expected. Emma confirmed they have Feliway plug-ins to help provide a calmer experience, and it did!

Unfortunately, Thrive did not have access to Mayzie's medical records, but Emma knew exactly who to contact and was persistent in getting the information they needed asap.

She took us into a private room that had a cat tree and Mayzie was able to explore and adjust while waiting on the Doctor. It was a short wait before Doctor long and another wonderfully kind Lady (can't remember her name, I'm sorry!) came in to chat with me.

They did not immediately start assessing Mayzie. Instead, they focused on me and all the details I could provide about her health before, during, and after the ER visit. This gave Mayzie a chance to relax around them and after 5-10 min. she greeted them both without hesitation. They were able to get her vitals and determine she was not in distress.

Doctor Long explained the medications that were provided by the ER and created a more manageable care plan. I was holding back tears because I was so relieved by the genuine care Dr. Long and her staff provided to us.

I will only be visiting Thrive Fountainview for my pet's healthcare moving forward. Thank you Ladies!!

I brought my dog, Chance, here and the entire staff was so kind and amazing. From the sweet young woman at the front desk to the vet herself and all of the nurses/vet techs. For once I did not feel like I was sitting around for hours waiting, they were on top of everything. Very thorough, very communicative, and answered all of my questions with patience. 10/10 would recommend.
Always a great experience from making an appointment through the whole experience . Highly recommend everyone that works there cares for you and your loved one.
Emma is literally the best every time I come she takes care of me so promptly and professional. Give her a raise!!
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback. Thank you for choosing Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview.
Been bringing my pups to Thrive for 20 yrs.  Great people, great & dependable service.  Dr. Long & Daisy are such assets to Thrive.
Doctor and Care team were kind and thorough. My pet and I both enjoyed the visit. They answered all of my questions and were reasonably priced. So glad I chose Thrive!

Emma the vet tech / nurse was amazing when dealing with my very large, vocal, anxious Shepard boy. Thanks so much for using your doggy voice, leveraging treats and positive energy to get Maxie to tolerate all the lab work that needed to be done today! I have had various experiences with various techs but Emma in particular did an amazing job and was thoroughly informative when explaining his remedies as well. Very soothing bedside manner for both pup and dog mom!
Your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview is our top priority. Thank you for choosing us for your pet's healthcare needs.
Everyone was very sweet when I bring my little Neo. The doctor was professional and explain everything to and answered my questions. I definitely recommend this location to others.

The team took great care of my sweet Mew cat! They were thorough, listened to my concerns, and were very sweet and gentle. I come here for the Fear Free experience for my nervous kitty! Thanks Dr. Myles & Elisa!
Great Job cleaning my dog’s teeth. Very kind and understanding, made sure she was comfortable and happy!

Very pleased with their service. Doctor Miller did an incredible job explaining us on how to proceed and made us feel confident. We recommend this place as it is very clean and well maintained. Staff was very friendly and very knowledgeable.

Took my friends frenchie here when he was having issues popping cause he went crazy on a bone. The staff here was super professional, informative, and supportive. They took the time to not only get to know Bruno like he was their own fur baby but also made me feel calmer about the scary situation. You can't beat their prices. They walked me through each option and prices and even formed a plan around my budget. Even called me the next day to check in on Bruno. Parking was a slight nightmare, but that's just cause of location and other shops in the strip mall. Once you do park and enter the vet office its 100% worth the parking war. Its very clean and if it wasn't for all the pictures and scale you would never even know it was a vet clinic.

I have been going to this vet for my sweet Rottweiler named Bella for the 5 years she was with us. Bella loved this vet and would always run inside excited to see her caregivers. When she passed, the vets and office have been truly helpful during this difficult time. Dr. Long even took the time to talk about her sudden passing to help me process. If you are deciding to bring your pet to this office I cannot recommend them enough. They are so caring and loving to the animals they see. I can assure that your pets needs will be fulfilled and they will do everything they can to help your pets physically and help you emotionally through the ups and downs. Thank you Thrive on fountain view! We love you!

Drove across town to pick up my dogs heartworm and tick prevention because the one in Pearland is closed.. just to see the lady leave 20 minutes before closing time. Waste of gas and I left without the items I need, which means I’ll have to make another trip back over here. I made sure I was here before closing and the sign on the bottom of the door says “the door will remain unlocked during business hours”. That’s a lie. I’m writing this review during business hours and the door is definitely locked. Thanks for nothing.
Thank you for the 5-star rating!

I can’t say enough good things about Thrive Fountainview. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me and my pet feel genuinely cared for. They were patient, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable—especially when my cat was anxious and hard to handle. They didn’t rush us, and they took the time to explain everything clearly.

The clinic is spotless and welcoming, and the team goes above and beyond to make sure your pet is comfortable. I also appreciate how transparent they are about pricing and options. It’s rare to find a vet that combines professionalism with such warmth.

If you’re looking for a place that treats your pet like family, this is it. Highly recommend!

When I entered the facility the receptionist Ms. Elisa greeted me with a good morning. She was very helpful and sweet to me and my furbaby. Once Ms.Elisa put us into a room Mr.Jack came in and showed my furbaby Midnite so much love. He pretty much had Midnite doing things that he had not done in a days. He was so helpful when explaining everything that could be done to help my fur baby. I love Jack energy. Dr. Willis is a sweetheart and was very detailed about my furbaby health. I love the staff and their energy. Thank you all so much for helping my furbaby. I seen a difference in Midnite once we got home and I put him in his bed. He got up walked to his food and started eating and drinking his water. Thank yall again.

Great experience as always. This has become my go to spot for the dogs. Good customer service and communication. A bit pricey but value is worth the level of care provided. Would suggest scheduling an appointment, not sure if they offer walk-ins or not but I tend to make my appointments in advance to ensure the fur babies are able to be seen. Cozy private rooms for the animals as you are consulting with the dr/ nurse. Comfortable front end area if you choose to be in the lobby. Plenty of parking for the location due to it being in a shared open retail plaza.

Dr. Long and the team at Thrive Fountain View went above and beyond for my dog, Jaxson. Despite a packed schedule, Dr. Long took the time to personally see him and provide the care he truly needed. Her compassion, professionalism, and genuine concern brought me so much peace. The entire staff was kind, welcoming, and treated us like family. I’m incredibly grateful, this team truly cares, and it shows in every detail. Thank you for restoring my faith in veterinary care.
Very good service and exceptional staff and Dr!!
Thank you so much for the feedback, Susan! We are so glad that you and your pet are part of the Thrive Pet Healthcare family. We appreciate the 5 stars!

Great and friendly service! Took in a stray 9 month pit bull (Maximus) and needed his first dose of vaccines. Made the process smooth for an excited pup and helpful to have the credit care option!
Maximus enjoyed the doggie treats.
Shoutout to Emma for brightening our day, and making a difficult process seem easy.

Just left my appointment (6/25)  and couldn’t wait to leave a review about how AMAZING this location is! We have been to other THRIVE locations in Austin and had a semi-bad experience during exams but this location was just PERFECT! From the front desk staff who greeted us with a smile to our technician TiTi who I can tell absolutely ADORES her job and loves animals and of course her WONDERFUL veterinarian Dr.Long , who answered any questions we asked and was so gentle and caring with our fur baby!!

I Definitely recommend this location for your animals and we will be signing up for their membership!
Thank you all for being so loving and patient 🫶🏾🫶🏾

We have been bringing our pets to Thrive since they were on Westheimer. Although Fountainview is farther, we have always been treated well here. On Friday I called after having to take my 10 year old dog to the ER. I was having a really hard time but the person who answered the phone listened compassionately. When I was done, we scheduled an appt for Saturday AM.

I received a text message to register. Super easy and convenient.

We arrived Saturday and everyone was so kind. We spoke with the tech who did triage. Then, spoke to the Vet. Everything was explained very well, a plan was put in place, and I signed up for ThrivePlus ($15/mo membership plan per pet).

I am very happy with the service, the plan, and the price.
$250. + for quick check & a lot of talk about what I need to do to better my cats life. Basically 3 shots  for $250 is insane.
The staff was very friendly and helpful. Dr. Myles was very thorough in diagnosing my baby. I will definitely recommend bringing your fur baby here.
Excellent service and most importantly great with Bon Bon. Thank you soooooo much. So glad Dr. Long was the one to treat her since she knows her history. Bon Bon is already better from her allergies.

I was so satisfied with the service provided to me and my two furballs! I highly recommend Thrive at the Fountainview location. Everyone especially the nurses and vets have great bed side manners. It’s my first time bringing my two cats to them, and we were treated with kindness and compassion. They also made sure that it’s not stressful for my cats, so they do everything they can to make you feel at home. Really happy with their service!

They took great care of my cat, Ash. I went there without appointment but they we so kind to squeeze me in somewhere. They have great service and the Vet, Nurse, front desk were all great. They even applied first time visit discount :)

Elisa and the doc were absolutely amazing. They were super sweet to my old little kitty and I’m blessed to have found a place that you can see, hear, and feel genuinely cares. Her tests and vaccines went smoothly and she got the treatment she needed.
Not going to any other vet in Houston!!! 🖤
We are so happy about your positive experience with us at Thrive - Fountainview!
Very clean and they treat pets well…they are very patient…they were super sweet with my Charlotte 🐶💕 …
I love this vet so much!! So responsive, always helpful and upfront about costs and procedures. I have been taking my dog since he was a puppy and have no complaints at all.
They always take care of my babies and get them on the right path .
They always treat us and our pets wonderful

I’m extremely disappointed with the care my cat received at this clinic. I brought her in three times for ongoing urine issues. The first two visits, they couldn’t even examine her properly. On the third visit, I paid $400 for them to sedate her and perform an ultrasound, but they still didn’t do the necessary urine test. They claimed there was nothing wrong, and recommended a diet change. Despite this, my cat continued to have blood in her urine, so I called again. They told me to get a urine exam and bring her back. However, when I called to follow up, they informed me I’d need to pay another $400 for a full exam again and that we don’t need the urine sample I just got , despite the fact that we already went through that process just a few months ago and were told everything looked fine. This feels like poor service and a lack of accountability, especially when my cat’s condition has not improved. I expect better transparency and care, especially when it comes to a pet’s health.

I have an 11 year old Lab/Shepherd mix with a super sensitive stomach. Dr. Rhooms is the only doctor who suggested a prescription diet to aid in digestion. We were at Banfield for 11 years and never once was an ID diet suggested. I've been cooking for my dog her whole life to keep her stomach normal. My dog seems to love the food the doc prescribed, even though she is usually picky! She is already getting better and gobbling up her food immediately. I've never seen her eat like this before! Thanks Dr. Rhooms!!

My husband and I brought our senior kitty here for the first time on the glowing recommendation of another senior cat owning friend. We'd had a hard time finding a vet we felt good with but Elisa and Dr. Smolik were great from the beginning making us feel like we were in the right place. I really appreciated the small details compared to other vets like the online check in features and being asked about doing the exam with the pet in the room or away from us. It was great feeling our concerns were really heard while being really transparent with the pricing so we could make the best choices for our family. So thankful and glad we finally have a place to help us navigate the scary world of aging pets!
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for choosing Thrive Pet Healthcare - Fountainview.

I don’t often leave tons of reviews but I am elated to leave a review for Dr. Long, Jack, and Elisa! I was timid because I have had my Panther and Greyson (frenchies) with Thrive but the original location the Dr. I trusted most with them left and after that I did continue to go but was not a fan and finally the facility closed after being open a short time.

I was hesitant about continuing with Thrive but Panther/Greyson have been with them since they were a few weeks old so starting with a new facility is truly a journey. I tried this location at Fountainview and was so pleased. Panther was not feeling well and we are not sure what the issue is just yet but I feel as though I am in good hands. Dr. Long and Jack made us feel comfortable and answered all questions that nervous pet parents could possible have.

From the receptionist to the technicians to the doctors—everyone here is incredibly caring, friendly, and compassionate. Special shoutout to Dr. Long who is so so positive, non-judgmental and so understanding.  I also adore the other doctor who works some weekends (except I forgot her name).  They go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable, always taking the time to answer questions with patience, understanding, and positivity. They don't pressure you to undertake expensive procedures or make you feel ashamed for considering costs.  One particular instance, Dr. Long called out the elephant in the room (expenses, dog age, etc.) when we were discussing an extremely expensive procedure.  I felt so understood and unjudged.

They're also so personable.  I mentioned once that weekend appointments are best for me, and after that, they've gone above and beyond to remember and offer weekend appointments for me.  For example, going as far as saying "I know weekend appointments work best for you, we have an opening on xyz Saturday that we can schedule for you."

They're also great with refilling prescriptions--both in person and through Chewy's for my auto-ship dog's prescriptions.

I couldn’t ask for a better veterinary team!
